entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A tumultuous plane of wild mana, unstable weather and floating terrain, wracked by the Roil.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: Volatile seismic movements that wrack Zendikar.

entities.name: The Hedrons
entities.description: Massive stone formations made by Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri, used to lure, contain and immobilize the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker who helped make the hedrons.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker who helped make the hedrons.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker who helped make the hedrons.

entities.name: The Eldrazi
entities.description: Three inscrutable entities of the Blind Eternities that devour worlds, once trapped in stasis on Zendikar and later released.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, home of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan destroyed near Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan destroyed near Sea Gate.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: A group whose four founders were Gideon Jura, Nissa Revane, Jace Beleren and Chandra Nalaar.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city near which Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: Home of proud and deadly vampire families.

events.summary: The ancient planeswalkers use the hedrons to lure, contain and immobilize the Eldrazi, who remain trapped for millennia.
events.quote: Unable to defeat the titans, the ancient Planeswalkers used the hedrons to lure, contain, and immobilize them.

events.summary: Younger planeswalkers inadvertently release the Eldrazi.
events.quote: until younger Planeswalkers inadvertently released them.

events.summary: The freed Eldrazi titans summon spawn and consume two of Zendikar's seven continents.
events.quote: consuming two of Zendikar's seven continents and leaving chalk deserts and warped Escher-scapes in their wake.

events.summary: The surviving Zendikari adapt and build alliances among kor, merfolk, elves, humans and vampire families.
events.quote: The Zendikari who endured the destruction adapted and built alliances

events.summary: With the help of the Gatewatch's four founders, the titans Ulamog and Kozilek are destroyed near Sea Gate.
events.quote: the titans Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed near the city of Sea Gate.

relations.note: Hedrons are the handiwork of Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri.
relations.quote: the ancient handiwork of the Planeswalkers Ugin, Sorin, and Nahiri the Lithomancer
the four founding Planeswalkers of the Gatewatch – Gideon Jura, Nissa Revane, Jace Beleren, and Chandra Nalaar

relations.note: Helped destroy the titans near Sea Gate.
relations.quote: the titans Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed near the city of Sea Gate.
